## Boundary

Describe exactly what execution boundary this change implements or validates.

## Contract

List the machine-readable contract changed or preserved.

## Validation

```sh
# Smallest reproducible command
```

## Independent reference

Describe the oracle, simulator, checkpoint binding, or external comparison.

## Evidence

List generated artifacts, hashes, and reviewed result notes.

## Limitations and non-claims

State what this change does not establish.

## Checklist

- [ ] Generated model assets, build products, traces, and local state are excluded.
- [ ] Arithmetic/interface changes update or preserve an explicit contract.
- [ ] New trust boundaries include negative or tamper coverage.
- [ ] Software, RTL simulation, synthesis, FPGA, and hardware claims are separated.
- [ ] Documentation and traceability match the implemented boundary.
